prompt_html: True or false: For a covered put strategy, the quote display shows the price of the stock leg plus the premium received for the put option
True or false: A covered put transaction can be created within the Strategy Builder in TWS.
True or false: A covered put position involves a short stock position plus a short call option.

True or false: A covered put strategy is used when an investor is mildly bearish on a stock and is taking a short position in the underlying stock while writing an option that would take delivery at a lower price under specific conditions.
